en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad cobbled avenue lined with young trees and late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century buildings with awnings and balconies. Well‑dressed pedestrians in long dresses and hats walk in the street, and a horse‑drawn cart stands in the foreground on the right. The cart has the inscription "H. Donat KOLBERG" on its back. Shops and cafés with striped awnings face the street, and further back more carriages and people are visible.
